notes.title: Unsouled Official Release Announcement
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=vUkZkqJJyIQ;full](정식출시 트레일러)[/previewyoutube]
Hey everyone, this is Team Unsouled!


We are finally graduating from early access and coming to you as ver1.0!
It was an extraordinary experience to actually hear your voices and experiment with many systems throughout the early access period. Thank you so much for the valuable feedback and continuous support.

Official Release Schedule
Specific release time for each timezone is listed below.
PST : 4/27 PM 04:00


Here is the new content that we’ve been preparing for the official release!

The first new piece of content is the Advanced Abyss.

Players may now summon up to five enemies they have met during gameplay and experience chaotic combat with the Advanced Abyss.

We’ve also added UI that shows the combo damage for players who like to check and experiment with their skills.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/69a4de60f80ff9fddd59a8f349037599afff2507.png[/img]


The ‘Mirror Dimension’ is another major piece of content included in this release.

The ‘Mirror Dimension’ is an additional challenge mode where players will find Gradiva that was touched during the gameplay.
Each Gradiva in the ‘Mirror Dimension’ will offer a challenge to the players and have them push their limits with many other missions!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/b1264b2b75cb42de8ac7cab3466f8f995e577e6a.png[/img]


We also have a special Twitter event to celebrate Unsouled’s official release, so come and check out the details :)


[b]Unsouled Official Release Twitter Event[/b]

[b][How to participate][/b]
[olist]
[*] Post a tweet with #Unsouled
[*] Include the phrase “4/27 Unsouled Official Release” in the tweet
[/olist]

[b][Event period and the prize][/b]
[olist]
[*] Event Period : 27th of April ~ 10th of May, (2 weeks)
[*] Prize : 10 lucky winners will win a Steam gift card worth $ 10 USD. It will be given through a friend invite.
[/olist]
[list]
[*] The prizes will be sent in order and there will be no further notice for those who did not win.
[/list]

Don’t miss the huge discount that will be ongoing for 2 weeks!

We hope everyone enjoys Unsouled! And once again, we’d like to sincerely thank everyone who has been supporting us and been with us throughout this journey.

We’ll be back soon with the post-release roadmap.

Thank you!
Team Unsouled

notes.title: Unsouled Early Access Patch Note #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/79ddd68eb2802b70eb7f021ac4234c413105a548.png[/img]
Hi everyone,

Ever since Early Access began on the 17th, we have received a lot of bug reports and improvement ideas. We’d like to say thank you, and will be reviewing each and every piece of feedback.

Among the feedback received, we have identified urgent issues that need to be prioritized for improvement and have applied fixes where possible.

Please find the details of today’s update below.

[b]1. Difficulty adjustment[/b]
A key trait of Unsouled is the sense of challenge and reward that comes from its hard difficulty. However, we have adjusted the balance of Prince of the fallen kingdom and Normal so that each difficulty is more distinct due to it being overly difficult.

[list]
[*] Increased the amount of Red Souls acquired in Prince of the fallen kingdom and Normal difficulty
[*] Added dash immunity time to Prince of the fallen kingdom and Normal difficulty
[*] Increased Attack and reduced damage when hit in Prince of the fallen kingdom and Normal difficulty
[*] Added Rookie Mode (on/off) to Prince of the fallen kingdom and Normal difficulty
[/list]

[b]2. Increased soul absorption speed when not in combat[/b]
It is possible to absorb souls during combat tactically, and it is directly related to boss difficulty. But, we have decided to adjust this due to feedback that the overall rhythm of the game is interrupted if souls are absorbed at the same speed even when out of combat.
[b]
3. Improved boss combat convenience[/b]
Boss fights are the core of Unsouled’s combat. Yet, sometimes it will be difficult to clear no matter how hard you try. Sometimes you may even need to start over to complete the Challenges! A restart feature that allows players to return to the very beginning of the Act and obtain souls for upgrade before facing the boss again was added. In addition, a quick restart feature that returns the player to the last save point is now also available.

[b]4. Modified difficulty based features in Act 2 during the part with the rolling rock[/b]
There was a good amount of feedback stating that the part where players have to avoid the rolling rock in Act 2 was overly difficult. As a result the difficulty level of Prince of the fallen kingdom and Normal was greatly reduced.

[b]5. Greatly increased the chances of acquiring Passive Soul when certain conditions are met
6. Skills can be used without additional upgrades when acquired
7. Modified the patterns of some bosses in each difficulty
8. Bug fixes[/b]

Aside from the above, other detailed improvements were also made.
We will continue to actively improve the game through user feedback during Early Access. Thank you for your feedback and interest!

Sincerely,
Unsouled Team.

notes.title: Early Access has started for Unsouled!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/d8e75670c6f8fc6a1cb53d4787e78534e8a51eda.png[/img]

notes.title: Unsouled’s Development Status and Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017726/79ddd68eb2802b70eb7f021ac4234c413105a548.png[/img]
Hello! Megusta Game here!

It’s been a while since our last post, but we’re back with some important news for you. Please see below for a detailed breakdown of the current development status of Unsouled and our plans for it in the future.


[b][Development Status][/b]
The main story of the game is all developed and prepared for the Early Access launch, and we are now working on 3 main features (listed below).
[b]
1. Currently Working on Boss Rush Mode[/b]
Defeating various Bosses with unique mechanisms is one of the best parts of the game. As a way to maximize the fun of boss fights, the Boss rush mode is under development and will be included in the Early Access version of the game. It will provide players with Unsouled’s signature stylish and fast-paced action.


[b]2. Perfect Balancing & Flesh Out Story[/b]
Game balance is one of the things that Unsouled cares about the most to enhance our game experience. We are adjusting the balance between enemies and the playable character in combat, so that first-time players can start with a moderately challenging level of difficulty. The game balance will be continuously revised throughout the EA period and a final check will be done through various tests in future.
Likewise, the story of the game is being revised in a big way so that players will be fully immersed in the game itself.



[b]3. Improve the UI/UX[/b]
When you play the game several times, the most eye-catching place is the interface related to the HP, stamina, and various souls. We are improving UI/UX in an intuitive way to make it easier to understand everything, and we welcome feedback about this during Early Access.




[b][Our Future Plans][/b]

Considering our current status, we plan to follow the roadmap outlined below. The Early Access launch has been delayed a little bit, but that will allow us to deliver a more polished game at launch and make some major changes to the overall plan.


[b]- July[/b]
-----------------------------------
1. Run a beta test for our backers and content creators.
   - Up to Chapter 3 will be playable and we plan to give access to all of our backers according to this schedule.
2. Reveal the Early Access Launch Trailer and new cover art.
3. Participate in the PLAYX4 Online Game Convention.
4. Take part in PAX Online to share Unsouled with the gaming community.
-----------------------------------

[b] - August [/b]
-----------------------------------
1. Finish QA and localization
-----------------------------------

 [b]- September[/b]
-----------------------------------
1. Launch the Early Access version on Steam and the Epic Game Store
Unsouled will be released on both the Epic Games Store as well as Steam, which will help grow our community and the Boss Rush mode will be included in the Early Access too.

2. Participate in Bitsummit (Japanese Game Convention) and the China Game Festival (Chinese Indie Game Convention).
-----------------------------------

[b] - December[/b]
-----------------------------------
1.  Update the ‘Roguelite Mode’.
-----------------------------------

[b] - 1Q 2022[/b]
-----------------------------------
1. Launch the 1.0 version of Unsouled on PC.
2. We’ll also do our best to release the Switch, Xbox and PS4 versions of Unsouled at or around this time.
-----------------------------------

That’s our plan as it stands now and we hope you like it. We’ll try our hardest to make the wait worth it for you and aim to make the best possible version of Unsouled that we can.

So please stay tuned!

Thank you!
